ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is triangle ABC, point H is inside the triangle, and H is connected respectively to A, B, and C. In the figure, at point B, 30° is marked between BA and BH; at point C, 28° is marked between CH and CB. The problem text states that H is the incenter of triangle ABC. Reasoning: Because H is the incenter, AH, BH, and CH are respectively the angle bisectors of the three interior angles of triangle ABC. Therefore ∠ABC = 2×30° = 60°, ∠ACB = 2×28° = 56°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so ∠BAC = 180° − 60° − 56° = 64°. Also because AH bisects ∠A, ∠HAC = 64°÷2 = 32°.

raw_record.question_text: $H$ is the incenter of $\triangle ABC$. Find $m\angle HAC$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: in triangle ABC, H is connected to A, B, and C. The angle at B between BA and BH is marked 30°, and the angle at C between HC and CB is marked 28°. From the text, H is the incenter of triangle ABC, so AH, BH, and CH are the internal angle bisectors. Therefore angle ABC = 2·30° = 60° and angle ACB = 2·28° = 56°. Use the triangle angle sum to get angle BAC = 180° − 60° − 56° = 64°. Since AH bisects angle A, angle HAC = 64°/2 = 32°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，点 H 在三角形内部，并且从 H 分别连到 A、B、C。图上在 B 点处，BA 与 BH 之间标有 30°；在 C 点处，CH 与 CB 之间标有 28°。题目文字说明 H 是三角形 ABC 的内心。
推理：因为 H 是内心，所以 AH、BH、CH 分别是三角形 ABC 三个内角的角平分线。因此 ∠ABC = 2×30° = 60°，∠ACB = 2×28° = 56°。三角形内角和为 180°，所以 ∠BAC = 180° − 60° − 56° = 64°。又因为 AH 平分 ∠A，所以 ∠HAC = 64°÷2 = 32°。
